data.name: Jaeen
data.gender_notes: Jaeen is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'ja'a', meaning 'to come'. Jaeen signifies a young, energetic individual, full of potential and growth. The name Jaeen carries the meaning “Youthful, energetic” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Jaeen usually hope their child will grow to embody youthful, energetic and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name with a youthful spirit, inspiring growth and progress.
data.etymology: Jaeen belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Youthful, energetic.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jaeen total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
